luau-list.name: Polynesian Cultural Center
luau-list.blurb: Polynesian villages, an imu luau and an evening show in Laie. Culture, not tiki - it has never used the word.
luau-list.check: Closed Sundays and most Wednesdays, and closed Dec 25 and Jan 1.
luau-list.order: Ali'i Luau, the villages and the evening show
luau-list.hours: Noon to 9 p.m. Closed Sundays, most Wednesdays, Dec 25 and Jan 1. Open Wednesday Dec 23 and Dec 30

luau-list.name: Old Lahaina Luau
luau-list.blurb: The traditional one: hula and history, no fire knife, and drinks for 21 and over. Lahaina's Front Street reopened Aug 1.
luau-list.check: No nights or holiday schedule posted. Call 808-667-1998. It often sells out.
luau-list.age: Adult tickets from age 13. Drinks for 21 and over with ID

luau-list.name: Feast at Mokapu
luau-list.blurb: A plated, oceanfront luau at the Andaz in Wailea, with holiday menus for Christmas and New Year's Eve.
luau-list.check: Dates for those holiday menus aren't posted. Not adults-only.

luau-list.name: Voyagers of the Pacific
luau-list.blurb: Kona's show luau, ending with a Samoan fire knife dance. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday.
luau-list.check: Christmas Day and New Year's Day aren't confirmed.

luau-list.name: Hawaii Loa Luau
luau-list.blurb: Chant-based storytelling with a smaller cast, Saturdays on the Kohala Coast.
luau-list.check: It has a keiki buffet station.

luau-list.name: Mauna Kea Luau
luau-list.address: 62-100 Mauna Kea Beach Drive, Kohala Coast, HI
luau-list.blurb: Formal and cultural, with aloha attire requested. Tuesdays and Fridays.
luau-list.check: Holiday-night operation isn't confirmed. Ask for the seating time.
luau-list.time: 4:45 to 8 p.m. Seating may start at 5:30, so ask.

luau-list.name: Hale Hoaloha Luau
luau-list.address: 68-1400 Mauna Lani Drive, Kohala Coast, HI
luau-list.blurb: A real imu and Makahiki games, with a smaller crowd than the big resort shows. Fridays.
luau-list.check: Mauna Lani limits dining to resort guests Dec 18 to Jan 3. Ask whether that covers the luau.

luau-list.name: Drums & Dances of Polynesia
luau-list.area: Royal Sonesta Kauai Resort, Kalapaki Bay
luau-list.address: Royal Sonesta Kauai, 3610 Rice St., Lihue
luau-list.blurb: The only luau here with a 21-and-over adult ticket, open bar and fire dancing. It runs Thursdays, so Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve both land on it.
luau-list.check: Not adults-only. Kids can come on a junior ticket.
luau-list.price: $180 adult before tax and fees, about $199 at checkout
luau-list.age: 21-and-over adult ticket with open bar. Juniors and children come on their own tickets

luau-list.name: Havaiki Nui Luau
luau-list.blurb: Grand Hyatt Kauaʻi's luau, Tuesdays and Saturdays, on the south shore.
luau-list.check: Not adult-labeled. Holiday nights not confirmed.

adult-stays.name: Romer House Waikiki
adult-stays.blurb: A small Waikiki hotel reported as 18 and over.
adult-stays.check: The hotel's site doesn't say. Confirm at 808-941-7777.
adult-stays.price: From $195 a night plus a $45 resort fee (2024)
adult-stays.age: Reported 18 and over. The hotel's own site doesn't say.

adult-stays.name: Hotel Wailea, Relais & Chateaux
adult-stays.blurb: Maui's only adults-only hotel. Everyone is 18 or older.
adult-stays.check: Its 2026 holiday dinners aren't announced yet. Last year's came out in mid-November.

closed.name: Paradise Cove Luau
closed.note: Closed. Many guides still list it.

closed.name: Luau Kalamaku
closed.note: Reopening after storm repairs isn't confirmed.

holiday_note: Christmas falls on a Friday. Almost no restaurant, truck or bar has posted holiday hours, so call ahead.
